name: Hardware Devices
description: Physical Ryu hardware: pair, manage, and control ESP32-based devices from the node, with device CRUD backed by the local device store.
tagline: Pair and control your Ryu devices

permission_levels.label: Can view
permission_levels.description: See the paired Ryu devices and their status.

permission_levels.label: Can pair
permission_levels.description: Pair new devices and unpair existing ones, which decides what physical hardware may talk to this node.

permission_levels.label: Can control
permission_levels.description: Send commands and dashboards to a paired device, changing what it shows and does in the room it sits in.
